site.sitedescription: Bog occupies a depression in an area of kame and kettle topography on the Valparaiso moraine. Surrounding vegetation: Oak-dominated woodland and agricultural land. Prior to European settlement, the vegetation is assumed to have been oak-hickory forest and prairie.
